title: Wuthering Waves - Attribute Anomaly Damage Formula

content.introduction: A comprehensive guide to the calculation of Attribute Anomaly damage and debuffs in Wuthering Waves.

main_formula.title: Anomaly Effect Damage Formula
main_formula.formula: Anomaly Damage = Anomaly Base × Occurrences × Boost × Anomaly Crit × DEF Multiplier × RES Multiplier × Final DMG

sections.title: Anomaly Base = B(L) × Elemental Coefficient
sections.description: The base damage of every anomaly effect is calculated by multiplying the level-based reference value B(L) by the elemental coefficient.
sections.formula: Anomaly Base = B(L) × Elemental Coefficient × Stack Function
details: B(L): Level-based anomaly reference value. Lv90 = 3674
Elemental coefficient · Stack function: Frost Chafe 203.77% [10 stacks], Fusion Burst 698.63% [10 stacks], Electro Flare 415.85% [10 stacks]

sections.title: Tick-Damage (Aero Erosion · Spectro Frazzle · Electro Flare)
sections.description: Triggers at fixed intervals while stacks are maintained, consuming 1 stack per trigger. Damage scales with the current stack count.
formula_conditions: Aero Erosion: 1 stack 1654 / n stacks 4134×(n−1)  (Lv90 basis)
Electro Flare: 3674×0.41585×n, stacks halved (floor) each tick, summed as decay series
sections.note: Only Electro Flare halves its stacks each tick, accumulating as a decay series.

sections.title: Stack-Burst (Frost Chafe · Fusion Burst)
sections.description: Explodes into a single heavy hit when stacks reach the maximum. Occurrences = applications ÷ max stacks.
formula_conditions: over = max(0, n−10): +33% per stack when team buffs exceed max stacks (summed with α, not multiplied separately)
sections.note: α: DMG-rate increase effect (applied only when present, default 0). The excess-stack bonus (0.33×over) is added into this same term alongside α, not multiplied as a separate factor.

sections.title: Debuff (Havoc Bane)
sections.description: A debuff-type anomaly effect that deals no direct damage.
sections.note: The DEF Reduction from Havoc Bane applies directly to anomaly damage, and multiplies with DEF Ignore effects for normal damage.

sections.title: Common Multiplier Chain
sections.description: The following multipliers are applied sequentially to the calculated Anomaly Base:
sections.formula: × Occurrences × Boost(1+Boost%) × Anomaly Crit × DEF Multiplier × RES Multiplier × Final DMG(1+Total DMG)

sections.title: DEF Multiplier
sections.description: Damage reduction multiplier from enemy defense:
sections.formula: DEF Multiplier = (800 + 8 × Resonator Level) / (800 + 8 × Resonator Level + (792 + 8 × Enemy Level) × (1 − DEF Reduction))
sections.note: Anomaly damage's DEF Multiplier does not factor in DEF Ignore — only DEF Reduction applies. (Normal damage factors in both DEF Ignore and DEF Reduction.)

sections.title: RES Multiplier
sections.description: Multiplier from enemy elemental resistance (same rules as normal damage): 0.8 + RES Pen; excess over-penetration is halved.
